historical_accuracy_notes: Timber-roofed three-aisled hall with clerestory and apse; Vitruvius (V.1) gives a width of 1/3 to 1/2 of the length. All dimensions (60 x 32 m, 9/17 m heights) are estimates; arched windows are recessed openings, no interior.
